title: 康方生物依沃西单抗胆道癌新适应症拟纳入优先审评，全球首创PD-1/VEGF双抗再拓实体瘤版图
content:
10月23日，CDE官网公示，康方生物的依沃西单抗注射液一项新适应症拟纳入优先审评，拟用于联合化疗一线治疗局部晚期或转移性胆道癌。图源：CDE官网此次申报进展与Ⅲ期临床研究HARMONi-GI1取得积极结果有关。2026年8月，康方生物宣布，该研究在预设期中分析中达到总生存期（OS）主要终点，并达到无进展生存期（PFS）和客观缓解率（ORR）的全部关键次要终点。一、胆道癌Ⅲ期研究取得阳性结果依沃西单抗是康方生物自主研发的PD-1/VEGF双特异性抗体，也是全球首创的PD-1/VEGF双特异性肿瘤免疫治疗药物。摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库显示，2024年该品种在中国首次上市。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库本次拟纳入优先审评的新适应症为依沃西单抗联合化疗一线治疗局部晚期或转移性胆道癌。在Ⅲ期临床研究AK112-309/HARMONi-GI1中，研究人员采用随机、双盲、对照、多中心设计，评估依沃西单抗联合化疗与度伐利尤单抗联合化疗一线治疗晚期胆道恶性肿瘤的疗效与安全性。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库2026年8月，康方生物宣布，经独立数据监察委员会（IDMC）评估的预设期中分析显示，HARMONi-GI1研究达到OS主要终点，结果具有统计学显著性；同时达到PFS和ORR的全部关键次要终点。康方生物在新闻稿中表示，度伐利尤单抗联合化疗是国内外指南共同推荐的一线标准治疗方案（SOC）。公司称，HARMONi-GI1是胆道癌领域首个以PD-L1单抗联合化疗为对照、取得OS显著阳性结果的Ⅲ期研究。该研究结果已入选2026年欧洲肿瘤内科学会（ESMO）大会突破性摘要（LBA8，主席论坛），康方生物将于大会首次披露具体研究数据。二、依沃西单抗持续拓展适应症目前，依沃西单抗已在中国获批三项适应症，覆盖EGFR-TKI耐药的非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（nsq-NSCLC）、PD-L1阳性非小细胞肺癌一线治疗及鳞状非小细胞肺癌一线治疗。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库除国内市场外，依沃西单抗也在推进海外商业化。2022年12月，康方生物将依沃西单抗部分海外权益授权给美国Summit Therapeutics，交易方案包括50亿美元以上的潜在付款及两位数百分比的销售提成。目前，依沃西单抗联合化疗用于第三代EGFR-TKI治疗后进展的EGFR突变非鳞状非小细胞肺癌的美国上市申请正在审评中。此次胆道癌新适应症拟纳入优先审评，意味着依沃西单抗在肺癌之外进一步拓展实体瘤治疗领域。后续研究具体数据及审评进展，值得持续关注。参考来源：[1] CDE官网[2] 摩熵医药（原药融云）数据库扩展阅读：1. 康方生物PD-1/VEGF双抗依沃西单抗注射液获批第3项NSCLC适应症，头对头击败替雷利珠2. 2026年全球双特异性抗体核心管线深度解析：依沃西单抗OS碾压PD-1，双抗ADC强势崛起3. 康方生物全球首创双特异性药依沃西单抗再拟纳入突破性治疗，聚焦三阴性乳腺癌新适应症

title: Sacituzumab tirumotecan shows significant clinical benefit in advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer
content:
Alongside the results from the TroFuse-005/ENGOT-en23/GOG-3095 study, data for first-line pembrolizumab monotherapy were presented
Two Presidential Symposium presentations at the ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October) reflect how the management of recurrent or advanced endometrial cancer is evolving in both first- and second-line settings.
For patients with disease relapse or progression after chemotherapy–immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy, there is an unmet need for effective treatment options, which has prompted the clinical investigation of antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) ( Clin Transl Oncol. 2025;27:4368–4380 ). One such ADC, the trophoblast cell surface antigen 2 (TROP2)-targeting sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT), resulted in significantly superior 12-month progression-free survival (PFS), one of the study’s primary endpoints, compared with treatment of physician’s choice (TPC), in patients with previously treated advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer in the phase III TroFuse-005/ENGOT-en23/GOG-3095 study ( LBA11 , key results in the box below). PFS was 29.4% with sac-TMT versus 12.4% with TPC (hazard ratio [HR] 0.59; p<0.0001), with almost a doubling of median PFS duration (7.2 months versus 3.9 months).
TROP2 is frequently overexpressed in endometrial cancer, including pMMR tumours. “Notably, almost 85% of the patients included in the study had pMMR disease and almost 80% had medium or high expression of TROP2. An approximate 40% reduction in the risk of progression or death at 1 year is an important improvement for these patients,” comments Dr Antonio González-Martín from Cancer Center Clínica Universidad de Navarra, Madrid, Spain.
The study’s other primary endpoint, overall survival (OS), was also significantly improved with sac-TMT compared with TPC at 12 months (63.4% versus 50.8%; HR 0.68; p=0.0001), with longer median OS (19.0 months versus 12.1 months).
While most (~75%) of the patients had received ≤2 prior lines of therapy, the remaining ~25% had received 3 prior lines. “To demonstrate this level of OS benefit in this setting is not only remarkable, but also clinically meaningful, because a 32% reduction in the risk of death and extension of median survival by 7 months is highly important to patients,” he adds. “While not currently validated, there is a signal that TROP2 could become a biomarker.”
Also presented at today’s Presidential Symposium was the 36-month PFS analysis from the phase III KEYNOTE-C93/GOG-3064/ENGOT-en15 study , where a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement was reported for first-line pembrolizumab monotherapy versus platinum-doublet chemotherapy in dMMR advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer (52.8% versus 30.0%; HR 0.57; p=0.0002) ( LBA12 , key results in the box below). The interim OS analysis showed a numerically favourable HR for pembrolizumab monotherapy, although the pre-specified significance criterion was not met (36-month OS: 70.7% versus 62.0%; HR 0.77). However, ~85% of patients who had disease progression on the platinum-doublet chemotherapy crossed over to receive pembrolizumab as part of the study, or any subsequent PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor off study. Supplementary analyses that adjusted for on-study crossover or subsequent off-study anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy revealed a greater OS benefit for pembrolizumab than platinum doublet (HRs 0.55–0.66 depending on the model).
“While the design of this study is good as it is based on a strong biomarker , ensuring that only patients with dMMR advanced or recurrent disease were included, a key issue is that the study’s comparator arm has become outdated: platinum-doublet chemotherapy alone is no longer the standard of care it was when the study was initiated,” highlights González-Martín. “The OS results were probably impacted by the high crossover rate, but a key difference between the treatments was a longer duration of response with pembrolizumab than platinum-doublet chemotherapy and greater disease control in the long term.”
“Beyond continuing to refine the role of immunotherapy for endometrial cancer for patients progressing to first-line chemotherapy plus immunotherapy, ADCs will undoubtedly become the standard of care . A biomarker for the selection of patients will therefore be a necessity for selecting the most appropriate therapy among a plethora of options,” González-Martín envisages. Future breakthroughs will likely emerge from ongoing research in the pMMR/MSS space that focuses on combinations of immunotherapy with targeted agents, such as ADCs . As first-line maintenance therapy, TroFuse-033/GOG-3119/ENGOT-en29 is investigating sacituzumab tirumotecan plus pembrolizumab ( NCT06952504 ) and BEHOLD-Endometrial02/GOG-3130/ENGOT-en33 is studying mocertatug rezetecan with dostarlimab or pembrolizumab ( NCT07684599 ). DESTINY-Endometrial01/GOG-3098/ENGOT-en24 ( NCT06989112 ) is evaluating first-line trastuzumab deruxtecan plus rilvegostomig or pembrolizumab in patients with HER2-expressing pMMR advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer and other first-line ADC trials are being instigated.

title: The future of dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer could be free from chemotherapy
content:
Promising results reported from the registrational AZUR-1 trial with dostarlimab
High rates of clinical complete response (cCR), defined as negative endoscopy, magnetic resonance imaging and computed tomography scan, were confirmed in an interim analysis of the phase II AZUR-1 trial , a global single-arm trial and the first registrational study evaluating the clinical benefit of dostarlimab monotherapy (once every 3 weeks for 9 cycles) in patients with mismatch repair deficient (dMMR)/microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) locally advanced rectal cancer ( LBA87 ).
As presented at the ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October), the cCR rate maintained for at least 12 months (cCR12) was 68% in 144 previously untreated evaluable patients who received 6-month treatment with the PD-1 inhibitor, dostarlimab, and had at least 12 months of follow-up. Responses were durable, with 98% of patients who achieved cCR maintaining their response for at least 12 months (2 patients had surgery and a pathological complete response [pCR]). Following dostarlimab alone, the cCR12 plus pCR rate was 76% (15 patients underwent surgery and 12 had a pCR), with no recurrences at the interim analysis. The safety profile was acceptable since 88% of patients completed all 9 cycles of dostarlimab.
The very positive findings from AZUR-1 build on the results from a much smaller, single-centre neoadjuvant trial in localised rectal cancer ( N Engl J Med. 2022;386:2363–2376 ) and “demonstrate that most patients can be spared chemoradiotherapy and surgery when PD-1 blockade is applied to locally advanced dMMR/MSI-H rectal adenocarcinoma,” according to Prof. David Tougeron from the University Hospital of Poitiers, France. cCR was high (68%) but lower than previously reported (100%; N Engl J Med. 2022;386:2363–2376 ).
Improving cCR while reducing the toxicity of current multimodality therapies, which includes bowel, urinary and sexual dysfunction and infertility, could be a huge step forward but these data are not yet available in AZUR-1. Only 3 patients (2%) discontinued dostarlimab due to adverse events related to treatment, and serious immune-mediated adverse events occurred rarely (grade ≥3 in 4 patients). “Median follow-up was only 26.3 months (range: 2–36 months), so longer-term outcome and safety data will be important,” explains Tougeron. “It would also be reassuring to see data on quality of life after dostarlimab treatment, which is severely impacted by current total neoadjuvant treatments.” In addition, cCR is an imperfect surrogate for pCR (12 patients among the 15 who underwent surgery had a pCR), and the investigator-central review discrepancy (47% versus 68%) demonstrates the difficulty of evaluating cCR.
AZUR-1 was a single-arm study due to the ethical considerations of performing a trial against chemotherapy, surgery and radiotherapy when evidence from smaller studies already supported the much higher cCR, better outcome and safety with dostarlimab treatment. “However, despite the very encouraging results, European regulators may be reluctant to approve dostarlimab treatment without randomised data,” Tougeron adds.
Accurate determination of mismatch repair status will be key if the regimen is used in the clinic. The use of both immunohistochemistry of the four MMR proteins and PCR/next-generation sequencing of tumour DNA is recommended to ensure that mismatch repair deficiency is confirmed before immunotherapy is started. Tougeron also highlights: “There are current difficulties in correctly assessing clinical complete responses and circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) could be useful to guide continuing immunotherapy and/or proceeding to surgery.” Such an approach is being explored in the ongoing RESET-R trial with nivolumab plus ipilimumab in resectable dMMR rectal cancer ( Ann. Oncol. 2026;37(Suppl. 1):S109–S110 ) and in the WINDOW trial with the anti-PD-1 antibody tislelizumab ( J Clin Oncol. 2025;43(Suppl 16):3559 ).

title: New targeted treatments raise the bar in immunotherapy-resistant melanoma
content:
Early-phase trial results for four novel therapies with antibody–drug conjugates and bispecific antibodies show promise after failure on first-line immune checkpoint inhibitors
Long-term survival in patients with advanced melanoma has improved substantially in recent years with the advent of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy, with overall survival (OS) rates of around 40% at 10 years following first-line ICI therapy ( N Engl J Med. 2025;392:11–22 ). However, two-thirds of patients experience primary or secondary resistance to immune checkpoint blockade, for whom there are few effective treatment options to date. Research into antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) and bispecific antibodies continues to grow in the melanoma setting, and it may result in new later-line treatment options to add to current effective first-line therapies as results for four novel treatments after failure on first-line ICI therapy, presented at the ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October), suggest.
In the phase II HERTHENA-PanTumor01 trial , results for the ADC, patritumab deruxtecan (HER3-DXd), revealed that in 42 patients with unresectable, locally advanced/metastatic melanoma that had progressed on prior anti-PD-1 therapies, the confirmed objective response rate (ORR) was 21% ( Abstract 2073RO , key results in the box below). The disease control rate (DCR) was 76%, median duration of response (DOR) was 8.0 months and median progression-free survival (PFS) was 5.3 months. Commenting on the results, Prof. Jessica Hassel from the Hospital Darmstadt, Germany, says, “The ORR and PFS are similar to the outcomes we see with lenvatinib–pembrolizumab so HER3-DXd may be a promising option. But I am concerned about the current cost of ADCs, which could make this treatment prohibitive.” Another critical aspect is the reported incidence of treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs; 95%), with grade ≥3 TRAEs occurring in 57% of patients. “Gastrointestinal events were among the most common and these can be a real problem for patients, having a detrimental impact on their quality of life,” she adds.
In a second ADC study, results for enfortumab vedotin in combination with pembrolizumab in the phase II PLUG-IN GEM 2301 trial revealed a confirmed ORR of 17.0% in 53 patients with refractory, advanced melanoma ( Abstract 2074RO , key results in the box below). Enfortumab vedotin is a nectin-4-directed ADC with monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE) payload, and it is known that MMAE-induced immunogenic cell death transforms non-inflamed tumours into an immune-active state, which can help re-sensitise them to continued PD-1 blockade ( Cell Rep Med. 2026;7:103021 ). In the study, the best overall response (BOR) was 28.3%, and the confirmed ORR was 17.0%, including 2 complete responses. Notably, the confirmed ORR was 15.4% in 45 patients with BRAF wild-type tumours, and 21.4% in 15 patients with BRAF -mutated tumours. “These results are interesting because for patients with BRAF -mutated melanoma, there is very rapid disease progression after failure on combined BRAF–MEK inhibitor therapy, and there are very few options that stop or slow this progression,” says Hassel. BOR results were also given by melanoma type: 23.3% for cutaneous, 50.0% for acral and 12.5% for mucosal melanoma. “The BOR of 50% in 12 patients with acral melanoma is highly interesting, although the disease stage, which varies widely in prognosis, is not described,” she notes. Asthenia (18% grade 1–2; 4% grade 3–4) was the most common TRAE, followed by pruritus (15% grade 1–2) and alopecia (14% grade 1–2).
A high rate of serious TRAEs was instead reported in a phase I dose expansion study investigating the tetravalent CD137/PD-L1 targeting bispecific antibody, FS222 , ( Abstract 2075RO , key results in the box below). “This is not surprising as FS222 targets both PD-L1 and the agonistic CD137 (4-1BB) checkpoint, resulting in conditional activation of T cells, which is associated with a greater incidence of side effects than agents that only block immune checkpoints. However, use of steroids appears to reduce the severity of the TRAEs,” says Hassel. Grade ≥3 TRAEs and serious TRAEs occurred in 45.2% and 33.3% of patients. Most TRAEs were hepatic events, primarily transaminase increases, and haematological events, including haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis-like events requiring corticosteroid treatment. One-third (33.3%) of patients required dose reductions due to TRAEs and 4 patients discontinued treatment because of TRAEs. Regarding efficacy, the bispecific antibody showed an ORR of 36%, median PFS of 3.7 months and PFS rate at 24 weeks of 29.6% among 42 patients with PD-1 inhibitor-resistant melanoma.
A different strategy was explored in a fourth study presented in Madrid, using GC101, an autologous tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) product that eliminates the need for post-infusion high-dose IL-2, thereby reducing the likelihood of associated toxicity ( Clin Cancer Bull. 2026;5:7 ). In the phase II MIZAR-003 study of 99 patients with advanced melanoma refractory to ≥2 prior systemic regimens (including anti-PD-1 therapy), grade ≥3 TRAEs occurred in 42.0% of patients in the GC101 group and 30.6% of patients who received investigator’s choice of chemotherapy ( LBA55 , key results in the box below). There were no IL-2-related toxicities. After a median follow-up of 8.3 months, the median PFS was 4.37 months with GC101 and 1.61 months with investigator’s choice of chemotherapy (hazard ratio 0.44; 95% confidence interval 0.28–0.70; p=0.0004), while median OS was not reached versus 12.55 months and ORR was 44.0% versus 8.2%, respectively. Significant benefit was seen in mucosal and acral subgroups. Hassel thinks that the types of melanoma could be a factor in the relatively low PFS, given the relatively high ORR. “The proportion of patients with acral or mucosal melanoma was high and this tumour type is notoriously resistant to treatment or is associated with short-lived responses compared with cutaneous melanoma,” she adds. “A key question now is how long does the response last with GC101. The PFS of ~4 months with GC101 could hint at a relatively shorter DOR than with lifileucel ( J Clin Oncol. 2025;43:3565–3572 ), although the populations studied are different,” Hassel suggests.
While further research will help determine the potential of these novel therapeutic approaches, Hassel sees some hope also for the future treatment of some of the more difficult-to-treat melanomas, such as acral melanoma . “For these patients, in the absence of a cure, maintenance of stable disease in the long term is now becoming a reality,” she concludes.

title: Novel T-cell-based therapies are demonstrating strong and durable responses in solid tumours
content:
Encouraging early-phase data are tempered by toxicity profiles and logistical challenges that could limit their wider adoption
While cellular therapies have proven remarkable efficacy in haematological malignancies ( Signal Transduct Target Ther. 2026;11:255 ), their use in solid tumours has come with additional hurdles, not only in identifying targets, but also in controlling the immune-mediated and on-target/off-tumour toxicities that can accompany treatment. Several presentations at the ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October) illustrate both the breadth of approaches now being investigated and the challenges that will need to be addressed as these therapies move towards wider use in a clinical setting.
Preferentially expressed Antigen in Melanoma (PRAME) has recently emerged as a promising candidate for T-cell receptor (TCR)-engineered T-cells in some clinical trials. It is a cancer testis antigen expressed during embryogenesis and at immune privileged sites, such as the testis but elsewhere, expression in healthy adult tissue is highly restricted, making it an attractive anticancer target ( Cell Prolif. 2020;53:e12770 ). As reported at the Congress, in a first-in-human phase I/II basket study of IMA402, a PRAME-targeted TCR-based bispecific T-cell engager , demonstrated favourable tolerability and encouraging antitumour activity in 126 heavily pre-treated patients with advanced solid tumours ( Abstract 1955RO , key results in the box below). A confirmed objective response rate (ORR) of 25% and disease control rate (DCR) of 63% was reported in 40 efficacy-evaluable patients.
“While the safety profile was favourable, adverse events such as cytokine release syndrome (CRS) present some challenges, even when low grade, as there is currently quite limited experience in managing these types of toxicity in many solid tumour clinics, making it important that they feature more prominently in medical oncology training curricula,” says Prof. Fiona Thistlethwaite from The Christie NHS Foundation Trust, Manchester, UK.
A manageable toxicity profile was shown in a second phase I basket study exploring the efficacy and safety of a PRAME-targeted T-cell therapy , IMA203CD8, modified to co-express a PRAME-directed TCR and CD8αβ with cytotoxicity directed against both CD8+ and CD4+ T cells ( Abstract 1946O , key results in the box below). The therapy was associated with a confirmed ORR of 41% in 90 heavily pre-treated efficacy-evaluable patients with PRAME-positive solid tumours, including melanoma, synovial sarcoma, ovarian and uterine cancers. “With T-cell therapies, one of the key metrics is durable remissions ,” Thistlethwaite adds, “and the longest response reported in this study is greater than 3 years, which is promising, although we need larger numbers of patients to more clearly determine clinical activity.”
Chimeric Antigen Receptor-T (CAR-T) cell therapy has been transformative in the treatment of haematological malignancies but has so far shown limited efficacy in many solid cancer trials due to factors such as tumour antigen heterogeneity and an immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment ( Med. 2026;7:101028 ; Lancet Reg Health Eur. 2026;64:101590 ). Encouraging efficacy was seen in a small phase I study (N=18) of a guanylyl cyclase 2C (GCC) CAR-T cell therapy in patients with advanced, heavily pre-treated colorectal cancer, albeit with significant toxicities noted ( Abstract 1003O , key results in the box below). “This represents a promising signal for patients with solid tumours,” says Thistlethwaite, commenting on the overall ORR of 39% (42% in the higher-dose cohort) and 36% in patients with liver metastases. All patients experienced primarily low-grade CRS, but a relatively high incidence of grade 3 diarrhoea (50% in the lower-dose and 83.3% in the higher-dose cohorts), rash (50% in the lower-dose and 16.7% in the higher-dose cohorts) and oral mucositis (16.7% in the lower-dose and 8.3% in the higher-dose cohorts) was reported. “Management of this frequency of grade 3 toxicity needs to be carefully considered as the trial moves into later phases and larger numbers of patients receive the therapy,” she adds.
Data were also presented for a first-in-class novel cell therapy (SL-28) that is mechanistically different from CAR-T and allogeneic cell therapies, and utilises allogeneic leukocytes modified for increased anticancer activity through recently discovered TezR receptors ( Receptors. 2022;1:13–53 ; Microb Cell Fact. 2022;21:202 ) to form ‘Tells’. The treatment was associated with a DCR of 100% in 10 patients with various difficult-to-treat advanced solid tumours (including adrenal neuroblastoma, pancreatic cancer, stomach and head and neck cancers), including 3 patients with bone metastases ( Abstract 1002O , key results in the box below). Despite the small patient number involved, Thistlethwaite acknowledges that, “The resolution of bone metastases is particularly interesting as with immunotherapy we tend to see responses in lymph nodes and certain organs such as the lungs, but rarely in bone metastases. These are tantalising results but it is too early to predict just yet how they will translate in clinical practice.”
While hope remains high that cellular therapies will be practice-changing for patients with solid tumours, further efforts are needed to optimise the efficacy–toxicity balance of cellular therapies . In addition, there remain complex logistical , economic and regulatory issues that, in Europe, are likely to result in disparities in patient access and impede widespread clinical adoption of these novel therapeutic modalities ( Lancet Reg Health Eur. 2026;64:101590 ). “As clinical development of cellular therapies progresses from early- to later-phase trials and beyond, and treatment delivery is scaled up, significant investment in infrastructure, manufacturing technology and specialised training will be required,” urges Thistlethwaite. In the UK for instance, the Advanced Therapy Treatment Centres (ATTC) Network exists to address the challenges of bringing pioneering advanced therapy medicinal products to patients across both oncology and non-oncology indications. The Network provides an important platform to share insights relating to the scale-up of staff training and education, guidelines to manage specific toxicities, standard operating procedures and interactions between pharmacists and stem cell laboratories to ensure the efficient delivery of treatments to patients. “ESMO can also help to support the wider oncology community so that a consistent approach is followed and patients benefit from greater and equitable access to these therapies across Europe,” she concludes.

10月26日，CDE官网显示，科伦博泰自主研发的B7-H3 ADC药物SKB500联合PD-1/VEGF双抗SKB118，用于小细胞肺癌（SCLC）患者的Ⅱ期临床试验申请获批。图源：CDE官网此次联用将B7-H3 ADC与同时靶向PD-1、VEGF通路的双抗相结合，进一步探索ADC联合免疫治疗在SCLC中的应用潜力。一、SKB500Ⅰ期数据公布，ORR最高达75%SKB500是一款科伦博泰自主研发的B7-H3 ADC，采用高亲和力、高亲水性及内吞作用更强的抗体，并通过可裂解的亲水性AAA连接子连接载荷，药物抗体比（DAR）约为8。2026年ESMO大会上，科伦博泰公布了SKB500治疗广泛期小细胞肺癌（ES-SCLC）的Ⅰ期研究数据。扩展队列共纳入61例既往接受过系统治疗的患者，所有患者均接受过含铂治疗，其中85.2%接受过PD-(L)1抑制剂治疗。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库截至2026年9月16日，12 mg/kg组和16 mg/kg组的中位随访时间分别为9.3个月和8.3个月，关键数据如下：客观缓解率（ORR）：分别为75.0%和66.7%。中位无进展生存期（mPFS）：分别为8.1个月和5.6个月。中位总生存期（mOS）：分别为14.0个月和10.6个月。安全性：两组≥3级治疗相关不良事件（TRAE）发生率分别为52.5%和66.7%，常见不良事件包括血液学毒性和胃肠道毒性，未报告治疗相关死亡。上述结果来自早期临床研究，后续仍需进一步验证。二、联合PD-1/VEGF双抗，拓展ADC联用策略SKB118（CR-001）由科伦博泰与Crescent联合开发，可同时靶向PD-1和VEGF通路，目前已在中国和美国启动单药Ⅰ期临床试验。此前，科伦博泰已推进SKB118与TROP2 ADC芦康沙妥珠单抗（sac-TMT）的联合开发。此次SKB500与SKB118的联用临床申请获批，进一步拓展了公司在ADC与双抗联合治疗领域的布局。同类联合方案也在持续探索。今年WCLC期间，BNT324/DB-1311联合PD-L1/VEGF双抗Pumitamig治疗肺癌的Ⅰb/Ⅱ期研究公布数据。在71例SCLC患者中，ORR为70.4%；按治疗线数划分，一线、二线及三线及以上患者的ORR分别为92.3%、77.3%和52.4%。这一研究为ADC联合PD-(L)1/VEGF双抗治疗SCLC提供了进一步的临床探索依据，但不同研究的患者人群和设计存在差异，相关数据不宜直接比较。三、多款创新药推进临床，研发管线持续拓展科伦博泰持续推进创新药研发。截至目前，科伦博泰已有3款1类新药获批上市，包括注射用芦康沙妥珠单抗、塔戈利单抗注射液和注射用博度曲妥珠单抗。图源：摩熵医药-中国药品审评数据库此外，科伦药业（含子公司）有超30款1类新药处于获批IND及以上阶段，涉及抗肿瘤药物、神经系统药物、系统用抗感染药物等疾病领域。

title: Detection of ctDNA fractions with a single tumour-informed and tumour-agnostic profiling assay strongly predicts relapse in lung cancer
content:
A cohort study from the TRACERx programme highlights the importance of integrating bioinformatics with whole genome sequencing
According to Dr Umberto Malapelle from University Federico II of Naples, Italy, data from a prospective cohort study presented in a Late-Breaking Abstract at the ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October) provide proof of principle that combined tumour-informed and tumour-agnostic cell-free DNA profiling can offer a comprehensive approach to minimal residual disease (MRD) detection.
In the study, circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA), detected at fractions as low as 2.1 parts per million (ppm) by error-corrected plasma whole-genome sequencing (WGS), strongly predicted cancer relapse and overall survival (OS) in 73 patients with stage I–III non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ( LBA94 ). MRD detection by tumour-informed and tumour-agnostic analyses was significantly associated with shorter relapse-free survival (hazard ratio [HR] 9.81; p=3.2´10 -9 ) and OS (HR 5.04; p=9.6´10 -6 ) compared with no MRD detection. The findings were validated in 50 patients with stage II–III colorectal cancer (CRC) from the prospective Danish IMPROVE study ( NCT03637686 ). In the CRC cohort, ctDNA analysis by ppm sequencing (ppmSeq) demonstrated a significantly shorter recurrence-free survival in patients with persistent versus cleared post-operative ctDNA (HR 5.45; p=5.29×10 -5 ).
“The authors have developed circulating mutational signatures unrelated to the tumour tissue to overcome the limitations of a tumour-informed assay . A large, prospective randomised trial is required to determine whether this unified strategy can become a new gold standard,” Malapelle comments.
The study was conducted as part of the TRAcking Cancer Evolution through therapy/Rx ( TRACERx ) programme that has previously established the prognostic value of tumour-informed ctDNA detection following curative-intent treatment in NSCLC, with post-operative MRD predicting relapse and death ( Nature. 2023;616:553–562 ; Nat Med. 2025;31:70–76 ). The platform utilises multi-region sequencing analysis to explore tumour evolutionary processes and can provide timely answers to ongoing questions relating to MRD detection.
A key challenge in using liquid biopsy-based next-generation sequencing for early cancer detection has been to improve sensitivity without reducing specificity. Sensitivity is limited by the number of mutations that can be tracked but can be improved by analysing mutations identified by tumour genotyping ( Sci Transl Med. 2020;12:eaaz8084 ). “Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and sequencing errors contribute to sequencing noise and false-positive results with standard WGS, but if sequencing errors can be suppressed using PCR-free, error-corrected plasma WGS incorporating plasma ppmSeq, thousands of patient-specific mutations can be analysed for MRD detection,” he concludes. “The study highlights the importance of integrating bioinformatics with WGS .”

title: 步长制药AGT小核酸BC923及PD-1/TIGIT双抗BC008-1A同日获批临床，剑指高血压与复发性脑胶质瘤
content:
10月29日，步长制药发布公告称，公司两家控股子公司同日收到国家药品监督管理局核准签发的《药物临床试验批准通知书》。其中，化学药品1类新药BC923注射液获准开展高血压适应症临床试验；生物制品1类新药BC008-1A注射液获准开展新增适应症临床试验，拟联合贝伐珠单抗治疗成人复发性CNS WHO 4级脑胶质瘤。两款1类新药同步取得临床进展，分别布局高血压和复发性脑胶质瘤，涉及AGT靶向小核酸药物、PD-1/TIGIT双特异性抗体两条技术路线。与此同时，步长制药的独家中成药前列舒通胶囊获得印度尼西亚药品上市许可批准，2025年国内销售额已超6亿元。从创新药研发到成熟品种出海，步长制药的产品布局正呈现出不同的发展路径。一、两款1类新药同日获批临床，分别布局高血压与脑胶质瘤BC923靶向血管紧张素原（AGT）—— 肾素 - 血管紧张素系统（RAS）上游前体蛋白，从源头抑制 AGT 合成、减少血管紧张素生成，为降压治疗提供不同于传统受体 / 酶抑制的新路径。全球范围内，AGT靶向小核酸药物仍处于研发阶段，尚无同靶点产品获批上市。国际研发进展较快的代表之一，是Alnylam开发的zilebesiran。其KARDIA-1、KARDIA-2两项Ⅱ期研究显示，皮下注射后降压效应可维持数月，展现出长间隔给药的潜力。截至2026年9月30日，公司在BC923注射液项目上投入的研发费用约为 3,205.73 万元。zilebesiran临床试验部分数据图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库BC008-1A为重组抗PD-1/TIGIT人源化双特异性抗体，可同时阻断两条免疫抑制信号通路。本次新增适应症拟联合贝伐珠单抗，探索免疫双靶点阻断与抗血管生成联合策略，直指治疗选择有限的复发性高级别脑胶质瘤。该药此前已获批实体瘤适应症临床试验，此次获批属于新增适应症的临床开发进展，并非首次进入临床阶段。截至2026年9月30日，公司在BC008-1A注射液项目上投入的研发费用约为11,668.71万元。二、超6亿大单品出海，国内销售额逐年增长10月21日，步长制药公告称，其全资子公司保定天浩制药生产的前列舒通胶囊获得印度尼西亚药品上市许可。这款国内年销售额超过6亿元的独家中成药，在国内市场持续增长的同时，也迎来了海外市场的新进展。前列舒通胶囊为国家医保乙类药品，功能主治为清热利湿、化瘀散结，适用于慢性前列腺炎、前列腺增生属湿热瘀阻证。据摩熵医药数据库数据显示，近年来，前列舒通胶囊在全终端销售额呈逐年增长趋势，2025年超过6亿元，2026年上半年超过3亿元，同比增长9.01%。从销售表现来看，该产品已形成一定的市场规模，此次获得印尼上市许可，也为其后续海外市场拓展提供了新的契机。

小核酸药物在过去五年迎来了管线的爆发式增长，但高速推进的另一面是同样不容忽视的失败率。全球1368个小核酸项目中，处于研发失败、停滞或拒绝上市状态的有455个，失败率约33.3%。2021年以来，259个管线进入失败或停滞状态，其中64.4%终止于药物发现或临床前阶段。更值得深思的是，一些管线在临床试验中成功实现了靶点调控——poly(GP)下降了48%，ATXN2蛋白显著降低，外显子跳跃水平优于已上市药物——却依然未能走到终点。靶点被成功调控，并不意味着疾病进程能够被改变；药效成立之后，安全窗口与产品价值仍决定研发成败。本文内容整理自摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》报告，结合摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库对全球小核酸项目全生命周期追踪能力，系统梳理近五年研发失败管线的结构性特征与代表性案例。摩熵医药数据库覆盖药物从靶点发现到临床终止的完整信息链条，为行业研究者识别“陷阱靶点”、理解失败逻辑、优化立项决策提供了可验证的数据底座。一、近五年小核酸药物研发失败管线：终止阶段与失败原因分布作为新兴生物技术，小核酸药物的开发仍存在诸多困难。据摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库统计，在全球1368个小核酸药物项目中，处于研发失败、无后续进展、拒绝上市等失败状态的有455个，研发失败率约33.3%。1. 研发失败风险前置近五年行业研发失败的风险呈现明显前置特征，大量管线的终止集中在早期转化与临床价值验证阶段。2021年以来，共有259个研发管线进入了研发失败状态，或是进入超过5年没有任何新进展的停滞状态。从研发终止前的进度来看，有167个管线研发终止于药物发现或临床前阶段，占比达到64.4%，其次是临床II期阶段，终止管线占比15.8%，小核酸药物的研发难点高度集中在早期转化与临床价值验证环节。数据来源：摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库小核酸药物前期研究向正式立项的转化概率较低，候选药物常脱靶导致毒性是重要原因之一。从整体研究终止的原因来看，早期研究未商业化/临床前未推进是占比最大的原因，合计占比32%。根据奥尼兰姆数据，约有40%的Galnac-siRNA候选序列在临床前的大鼠独立筛选阶段中因为肝毒性而被淘汰，而这一肝毒性是siRNA与非目标RNA发生seed区脱靶配对导致的，可见对于小核酸药物，靶向递送与精准识别是药物研发前期阻碍推进的重大壁垒。图片来源：摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》2. 临床阶段小核酸药物推进壁垒临床阶段小核酸药物最大推进壁垒在于证明其临床价值。从不同研发阶段的终止原因分布来看，药物研发前期（药物发现、临床前）的管线，最常因战略管线优先级调整、早期研究未商业化等原因终止；而进入临床阶段后，因疗效不足、未达主要终点终止的管线占比开始显著上升。即便项目成功完成立项推进到临床，小核酸药物仍容易在临床阶段暴露临床获益不足的问题，这也表明行业在立项前的调研预测工作，仍然存在较大的优化空间。二、小核酸药物研发高失败率靶点分布在近年失败的259个管线中，有83个管线未公布其具体靶点。在剩余有靶点信息的失败管线中，涉及靶点135个，整体靶点集中度较低，较少有明显的“陷阱”靶点。但其中仍有20个靶点的开发失败率超过60%，ICAM1、SCNN1A等9个靶点失败率高达100%，体现出相当高的开发难度。1. DMD：研发热情与失败率双高DMD靶点同时具有高研发热情与高失败率。作为杜氏肌营养不良症的核心靶点，近5年有32个管线针对DMD进行研发，但失败率高达62.5%，有20个管线宣告失败。其中，BioMarin、WAVE Life Sciences曾分别将管线推进至II期与III期临床，但均因疗效不达预期而终止研发。2. TLR9：跨领域开发的高难度样本TLR9靶点作为免疫通路中的关键蛋白，近五年同样拥有较高的研发热情，目标适应症横跨癌症、呼吸系统、胃肠道、炎症、神经系统、免疫调节、皮肤病、肌肉骨骼系统与血液系统等多个领域，但其失败率同样高达62.5%（8个研发管线中5个失败）。Karolinska曾将对应药物cobitollmod推进至III期临床，但因无法达成临床终点而全面终止开发。三、小核酸药物研发失败代表性案例盘点梳理上述失败管线不难发现，两类问题最为典型：其一，靶点被成功调控，并不意味着疾病进程能够被改变；其二，药效成立之后，安全窗口与产品价值仍决定研发成败。以下四个案例，正是这两类困境的缩影。场景一：靶点调控实现，不等于疾病进程得到改善1. 案例一：WVE-004（C9orf72靶点，ASO）WVE-004是Wave Life Sciences开发的一款靶向C9orf72的ASO药物，适应症为C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD），最高研发阶段为Phase I/II。C9orf72基因中的六核苷酸重复扩增是ALS和FTD最常见的遗传病因之一，其异常转录产物poly(GP)被认为具有神经毒性。WVE-004的设计逻辑是通过降解含有异常扩增的C9orf72转录本，降低poly(GP)水平，从而减轻神经毒性。临床前研究中，WVE-004能够有效降低患者来源神经细胞的poly-GP，且保留正常转录本；小鼠实验中，药品展现了长期药效，成功降低脊髓与皮层的poly-GP。2022年临床试验中，实验组出现了显著的poly-GP下降，但神经损伤标记NFL及临床功能没有显著改善，公司选择继续推进实验。2023年，在更多患者入组与进行更长期试验后，NFL与临床功能依然没有出现显著改善，公司宣布终止研发。研发时间轴：2018年：临床前研究2021年：启动临床I/II期2023年：临床结束，宣布终止研发失败启示：即使靶点调控获得预期结果，其距离最终疾病获益仍然有着距离。2. 案例二：BIIB105（ION541，ATXN2靶点，ASO）BIIB105是Ionis授权Biogen开发的一款靶向ATXN2的ASO药物，同样用于ALS治疗。ATXN2编码ataxin-2蛋白，其多聚谷氨酰胺扩增与ALS风险相关，被认为通过促进TDP-43蛋白的异常聚集参与疾病进程。临床前小鼠实验中，通过遗传学手段降低ATXN2或使用ATXN2 ASO均能显著降低TDP-43聚集并延长小鼠生存时间，展现出强大的临床潜力。图片来源：摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》2020年启动的I/II期ALSpire研究（n=99）中，BIIB105实现了脑脊液中ATXN2蛋白的统计学显著降低。然而，在6个月的安慰剂对照期内，BIIB105未能降低血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平——NfL是神经退行性变和神经元损伤的标志物。功能、呼吸和肌力等临床终点同样没有改善。在超过40周的开放标签扩展随访中，ATXN2的持续降低并未转化为NfL或临床功能的任何改善。2024年5月，Biogen和Ionis宣布终止BIIB105的开发。研发时间轴：2013年：Ionis授权Biogen开发2020年：启动临床I/II期2024年：宣布终止研发失败原因：靶向机制明确且在人体内展现积极信号，但未能转化为疾病获益。失败启示：与WVE-004类似，即使设计的路径在动物模型中获得了积极结果，靶点调控也达到预期，但距离最终的患者获益仍存在较大差距。小核酸药物的新靶点开发仍然有着巨大的不确定性。场景二：药效达标，安全窗口与产品价值决定研发成败3. 案例三：SRP-5051（DMD外显子51跳跃，肽偶联PMO）SRP-5051（vesleteplirsen）是Sarepta开发的一款多肽偶联PMO（PPMO）药物，通过诱导DMD基因外显子51跳跃、恢复抗肌萎缩蛋白表达来治疗杜氏肌营养不良症。与WVE-004和BIIB105不同，SRP-5051在临床试验中展现了明确的疗效信号。在II期MOMENTUM研究的Part A中，SRP-5051观察到了显著的外显子跳跃和肌营养不良蛋白表达上升，且呈现剂量依赖关系，药物在试验过程中呈现良好的可耐受性，未出现显著的安全性信号。在Part B中，公司继续推高剂量，并于2021年观察到了显著优于已上市外显子跳跃药物的跳跃水平和肌营养不良蛋白表达水平。但随之而来的是安全性问题。早在研究早期，低镁血症（血镁水平偏低）的风险就已被识别，当时被判断为“可监测、可管理”。然而在后续研究中，部分患者出现了持续性的低镁血症，且即使在停药后仍然存在，同时伴有eGFR下降（肾功能指标恶化）。2024年11月，Sarepta宣布终止SRP-5051的开发，理由是长期安全性和耐受性的考量。SRP-5051的失败提供了一个与前述神经领域案例截然不同的教训：当疗效已经成立，安全窗口便成为产品价值的唯一裁判。外显子跳跃水平和肌营养不良蛋白表达的数据是令人鼓舞的，但持续性的低镁血症和肾功能下降意味着药物的治疗窗口过窄——在能够产生疗效的剂量下，安全性风险超出了可接受的范围。这一案例的核心启示在于：对于早期出现的安全性问题，应当尽早评估其剂量依赖性和可逆性，避免在研发后期因安全性风险积累而导致全部投入付诸东流。4. 案例四：Vupanorsen（ANGPTL3靶点，GalNAc-ASO）Vupanorsen是Ionis发现、辉瑞引进的GalNAc-ASO药物，靶向ANGPTL3，适应症为血脂异常与心代谢疾病，最高研发阶段推进至IIb期临床。ANGPTL3是一个经过人类遗传学充分验证的靶点——ANGPTL3功能缺失突变携带者具有较低的LDL-C、甘油三酯水平和冠心病风险。2016年的临床I期试验中，实验组体内ANGPTL3的表达下降83%，同时带来甘油三酯最大平均下降66%、LDL-C最大平均下降35%的显著结果。进入临床IIa期试验后，主要终点再次达标，甘油三酯相较安慰剂组下降约44%，non-HDL-C下降约18%，总胆固醇下降约19%，但LDL-C对比安慰剂组没有出现显著下降，脂肪肝、糖代谢指标等也没有得到显著改善。进入IIb期试验后，在加大药物剂量后获得了更显著的ANGPTL3与甘油三酯下降结果，但non-HDL-C仅下降约22-27.7%，LDL-C仅下降8%-16%，ApoB下降约6-15%，同时加大药量后出现了部分肝脏安全性问题，最终公司宣布终止研发。 研发时间轴：2013年：药物发现2015年：启动临床I期2017年：临床IIa期（高脂血症、脂肪肝）2018年：临床I/II期2019年：辉瑞引进开发2020年：临床IIb期（高脂血症）2022年：宣布终止研发失败原因：尽管证实能够导向临床获益，但获益不足使得药物缺乏继续开发的价值。这款药物的失败留给行业的启示是，即便已经有上市药品Evinacumab证明该靶点整体成药性可行，临床结果也证明药物的作用机制能够带来部分指标改善，但如果最终的临床获益与药物最初的开发期望存在明显差距，不足以支撑药物最终走向上市。结语复盘近五年小核酸失败管线不难发现，研发风险贯穿从临床前到 II 期临床的全流程，失败诱因已经从早期单纯的递送难题，逐步转向靶点生物学验证、分子信号向临床获益转化、安全窗口评估等更深层问题。但失败不是小核酸药物故事的反面，而是它的一部分。对于药企研发人员、项目决策者而言，依托摩熵医药数据库持续对标同靶点、同递送技术、同适应症项目的临床推进节奏与终止案例，读懂靶点冷热与失败底层逻辑，才能在管线立项、临床方案设计阶段识别潜在风险，提升小核酸药物研发的成功率。相关拓展阅读：1. content:
10月20日，摩熵医药中国药品审评数据库显示，康缘药业联合图锋医药、北峰药业及上海中医药大学申报的中药1.1类新药十味安肠颗粒获批临床，拟用于溃疡性结肠炎。图源：摩熵医药-中国药品审评数据库一、聚焦溃疡性结肠炎，康缘再推创新中药十味安肠颗粒由江苏康缘药业股份有限公司联合上海图锋医药科技有限公司、辽宁北峰药业有限公司及上海中医药大学共同研发，是一款基于中医临床经验方开发的现代中药颗粒制剂。据摩熵医药数据库显示，该药于2026年8月12日首次提交临床试验申请，受理号为CXZL2600075，并于10月20日首次获批临床。图源：摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库此次获批的适应症为溃疡性结肠炎。作为中药1.1类创新药，十味安肠颗粒后续临床研究进展及疗效、安全性数据值得关注。康缘药业在肠道疾病领域已有其他创新中药布局。公司另一款中药1.1类新药健脾疏肝固本颗粒此前已获得临床试验默示许可，拟用于腹泻型肠易激综合征（肝郁脾虚证）。两款产品针对不同适应症，体现了公司在中药创新药领域的持续布局。在成熟中成药方面，康缘药业拥有天舒胶囊、天舒片、苁蓉总苷胶囊等独家产品，属于神经系统疾病用药领域。摩熵医药数据库显示，天舒胶囊2025年全终端销售额超过2亿元，2026年上半年销售额约0.68亿元。

title: Pelthos Therapeutics与Castle Creek Biosciences合并，打造聚焦皮肤重症的生物科技公司【AI生成】
content:
生物制药公司Pelthos Therapeutics Inc.（NYSE American: PTHS）与处于临床后期阶段、致力于开发可重复给药基因疗法的Castle Creek Biosciences, Inc.宣布达成最终合并协议。此次战略整合旨在创建一家具有变革意义的生物技术公司，结合Castle Creek基于成纤维细胞的细胞与基因治疗平台及Pelthos在皮肤科领域的商业化能力，共同针对影响皮肤的严重疾病。合并后公司将沿用Pelthos名称并在NYSE American上市。核心产品为Castle Creek的D-Fi (dabocemagene autoficel; FCX-007)，这是一种通过皮内注射每两个月一次的基因修饰细胞疗法，已获孤儿药认定，目前正进行III期临床试验以治疗营养不良性大疱性表皮松解症（DEB）。该药物通过递送产生VII型胶原蛋白（COL7）的细胞来修复伤口并降低鳞状细胞癌风险。此外，Castle Creek还利用其专有技术开发D-Fi的外用制剂，并拓展至其他皮肤恶性肿瘤及炎症性疾病领域。双方高管表示，此举将加速D-Fi的市场推出，增强公司在儿科皮肤科的优势，并为股东创造长期价值。

10月28日，恒瑞医药发布2026年第三季度报告。第三季度，公司实现营业收入89.53亿元，同比增长20.55%；归母净利润24.58亿元，同比增长88.92%；利润总额27.76亿元，同比增长103.97%。前三季度，公司实现营业收入244.09亿元，归母净利润69.23亿元，同比增长20.38%。图源：恒瑞医药2026年第三季度报告业绩增长的同时，恒瑞医药创新药业务也有新进展。CDE官网同日公示，公司自主研发的ADC药物瑞康曲妥珠单抗一项新适应症上市申请获受理。结合该药此前的临床研究及审评进展，此次申报可能涉及HER2阳性复发或转移性乳腺癌一线治疗，具体适应症仍需以官方披露为准。一、创新药销售超138亿元，对外授权持续贡献收入从前三季度经营情况来看，创新药已成为恒瑞医药收入的重要组成部分。2026年前三季度，公司创新药销售收入达138.71亿元，同比增长17.05%，占药品销售收入的比重提升至64.59%。其中，抗肿瘤创新产品收入98.65亿元，同比增长3.13%，占创新药销售收入的71.12%；非肿瘤创新产品收入40.06亿元，同比增长75.36%，占比达到28.88%。图源：整合于恒瑞医药2026年第三季度报告除产品销售外，创新药对外许可业务也为公司带来收入增量。前三季度，恒瑞医药创新药对外许可业务确认收入27.81亿元，同比增长31.12%，主要来自GSK、BMS相关合作的进度确认收入，以及个别已授权产品的里程碑款。同期，公司收到对外许可合作首付款及里程碑款现金共43.43亿元，主要包括BMS支付的6亿美元首付款。第三季度单季确认许可收入约13.6亿元，这类收入具有较高毛利率。在已授权项目持续贡献收入的同时，恒瑞医药也在拓展新的海外合作。2026年9月，公司与诺和诺德达成协议，将每周一次口服给药的GLP-1/GIP双受体激动剂HRS-1596有偿许可给诺和诺德，授予其大中华地区以外全球范围内的开发、生产和商业化独家权利。该交易潜在总金额最高可达26亿美元，包括3亿美元首付款，以及后续开发、注册和商业化里程碑付款及销售提成。另一条出海路径是NewCo模式。8月6日，恒瑞医药的合作伙伴Braveheart Bio登陆美国纳斯达克。此前，恒瑞将自主研发的心肌肌球蛋白小分子抑制剂HRS-1893有偿许可给Braveheart Bio，并获得该公司部分股权。这是继今年4月Kailera Therapeutics登陆纳斯达克后，恒瑞医药NewCo模式取得的又一进展。二、多款创新药上市申请获受理，研发管线持续推进销售与授权业务之外，创新药研发及上市申报进展同样值得关注。2026年第三季度，恒瑞医药共有7项上市申请获CDE受理，其中GLP-1相关产品取得多项进展。企业公告+摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库整合具体来看，口服GLP-1受体激动剂HRS-7535片用于成人2型糖尿病患者血糖控制、成人长期体重管理的两项上市申请均获受理；GLP-1/GIP双受体激动剂瑞普泊肽注射液用于成人2型糖尿病患者血糖控制的上市申请也获受理。从产品储备来看，截至目前，恒瑞医药已有27款1类创新药和6款2类新药在中国获批上市，另有100多个自主创新产品处于临床开发阶段，400余项临床试验在国内外开展。多款产品推进上市申报，也为公司后续创新药商业化提供了新的观察窗口。

小核酸药物正从罕见病与遗传病的小众应用场景，稳步拓展至肿瘤、心血管及代谢疾病等更广阔的疾病治疗版图，是当下创新药研发领域最具发展潜力的方向之一。该类药物以10—50个核苷酸组成的短链核酸分子为活性成分，能够突破传统药物“难以成药”的靶点壁垒，通过降解、沉默或抑制特定基因表达，从源头调控疾病发生机制，同时具备作用效率高、研发周期短、平台可复用等独特优势。当前小核酸药物已形成反义寡核苷酸（ASO）、小干扰 RNA（siRNA）、微小 RNA（miRNA）、适体（Aptamer）四大主流品类。依托化学修饰、GalNAc偶联、LNP包载、抗体/多肽偶联等多元化递送技术的持续迭代，其临床应用边界不断拓宽，全面覆盖肿瘤、眼科疾病、中枢神经系统疾病、遗传及罕见病、心血管及代谢性疾病五大核心领域，全球潜在市场规模约8500亿美元。凭借持续升级的技术体系与不断落地的临床价值，小核酸药物已然成为继小分子药物、抗体药物之后又一值得长期关注的新药研发热点。本文核心内容均摘编自摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》报告。该报告依托摩熵医药数据库海量生物医药全产业链数据，从技术概览、行业沿革、市场格局、在研管线、终止研发管线等多个维度，系统梳理行业发展全貌，精准研判研发热点与潜在风险，深度挖掘赛道增长潜力。本文结合前沿技术特征与产业落地现状，系统整合并梳理了小核酸药物的技术体系、临床应用场景、主流递送技术及行业发展核心挑战。一、小核酸药物概览：技术分类与核心价值小核酸药物（small nucleic acid drugs）是由10—50个核苷酸构成的短链核酸分子，按药理载荷可分为反义寡核苷酸（ASO）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微小RNA（miRNA）与适体（Aptamer）药物等。作为核酸药物的一类，小核酸药物具有作用效率高、研发周期较短等特点，已成为新药研发领域的研究热点。1. 主要分类ASO（反义寡核苷酸）：结构上通常为单链的寡核苷酸；通过与靶RNA序列互补结合，实现RNA降解、剪接调控或翻译阻断的目的。siRNA（小干扰RNA）：通常为双链RNA；经RISC复合物介导，特异性降解靶RNA，实现基因沉默。miRNA（微小RNA）：miRNA类药物可通过模拟或抑制内源性miRNA，调控相关基因表达网络。Aptamer（适体药物）：化学本质常为DNA或RNA，通过特定三维空间构象与靶标结合，蛋白质是目前最常见的靶标。2. 作用机制小核酸药物的作用机制主要分为两类：（1）基因表达调控型：以ASO、siRNA和miRNA为代表，通过靶RNA识别，实现RNA降解或剪接调控，进而改变蛋白表达水平。（2）靶标直接结合型：以适体药物为代表，通过核酸链折叠形成三维构象，直接结合蛋白或细胞等靶标，阻断或调节靶点功能。3. 临床价值这种特殊的作用模式也赋予了小核酸药物显著的临床价值：它能够针对传统药物难以成药的靶点，大幅拓展疾病治疗的边界；序列设计具备天然的平台复用性，企业可以基于同一技术框架快速拓展新靶点与新适应症；在遗传病、罕见病及常见慢性病领域都展现出极高的应用潜力；部分成熟技术路线的产品还能实现数月一次的长效给药，部分前沿研究甚至在向接近一次性治疗的目标推进。4. 关键挑战目前小核酸药物行业仍处于高速发展期，技术落地与产业化仍面临多重瓶颈。首先，药物有效成分体内稳定性不足，极易被体内核酸酶降解，直接影响药效发挥；其次，组织与细胞特异性递送是行业核心技术瓶颈，严重制约药物生物利用率与靶向精准度；再次，药物应用存在脱靶效应、非特异性免疫激活及长期安全性未知等风险，临床应用安全性仍需持续验证；最后，药物生产工艺复杂，生产成本、质量控制及规模化量产的技术标准严苛，产业化门槛较高。整体来看，未来小核酸药物的行业竞争，将集中聚焦于靶点精准筛选、高效递送技术突破、用药安全性优化三大核心方向。二、小核酸药物的主要治疗领域小核酸药物横跨肿瘤、眼科疾病、中枢神经系统、遗传病及罕见病、心血管及代谢性疾病五大市场，潜在市场规模约8500亿美元，展现出广阔的应用潜力。图片来源：摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》心血管及代谢性疾病（2400亿美元市场）：高胆固醇血症、高甘油三酯血症、高血压、血栓疾病等。遗传病及罕见病（2358亿美元市场）：血友病A/B、遗传性血管性水肿、肝性卟啉症、家族性淀粉样变多发性神经病等。中枢神经系统（334亿美元市场）：肌萎缩侧索硬化、运动神经元病等。眼科疾病（600亿美元市场）：地图状萎缩、年龄相关性黄斑变性、湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性、巨细胞病毒视网膜炎等。肿瘤（2864亿美元市场）：骨髓发育异常综合征、胰腺癌等。其他：角膜移植排斥、慢性疲劳综合征等。目前，小核酸药物已经在心血管及代谢性疾病、遗传病、罕见病等领域展现出较高的应用潜力。以肌萎缩侧索硬化（渐冻症）为例，该疾病由超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）基因突变引发，传统药物研发长期陷入困境，核心原因是SOD1蛋白结构高度稳定，无适配传统药物结合的作用位点，始终缺乏有效治疗手段。而小核酸药物托夫生（Tofersen）可直接靶向致病基因与RNA，从疾病根源干预病情发展，为渐冻症治疗开辟全新路径。该药物于2023年获批上市，2024年正式进入中国市场，落地惠及国内罕见病患者，充分印证了小核酸药物的独特临床价值。三、小核酸药物的主要递送方式递送技术被普遍视为小核酸药物研发的核心胜负手。当前上市产品以化学修饰及GalNAc偶联最为常见，同时以LNP（脂质纳米颗粒）及抗体/多肽偶联探索肝外靶向。1. 化学修饰直接给药主要用于ASO与适体药物，常见给药部位为玻璃体内、鞘内、皮下与局部。其核心逻辑是依靠PS／2’位修饰或PEG化增强稳定性，无需复杂载体。作为最成熟的技术路线，它特别适合局部用药或可直接到达靶组织的场景，代表药品包括Fomivirsen、Nusinersen、Tofersen（托夫生）与Pegaptanib。2. GalNAc偶联主要用于以siRNA为主、部分ASO的药物，靶向肝细胞ASGPR，可实现皮下注射、低频给药与明确的肝靶向，是当前肝靶向小核酸的核心平台。代表产品包括Givosiran、Lumasiran、Inclisiran（英克司兰钠）、Vutrisiran与Eplontersen。3. LNP包载主要用于以siRNA为主、部分miRNA及双链RNA的探索。其递送逻辑是包载保护核酸，促进细胞摄取与内体逃逸，适用于需要系统给药、需要额外包载保护的RNA载荷。其系统性递送验证充分，但产品数量少于GalNAc，代表产品为Patisiran。4. 抗体/多肽偶联主要用于ASO与siRNA，目标是突破肝外组织，聚焦肌肉、心肌及中枢神经系统；其核心价值在于利用受体介导内吞实现细胞定向递送。该路线临床推进较快，是肝外递送的重要方向，代表在研项目包括Del-desiran（AOC 1001）、DYNE-101等。需要补充的是，化学修饰是多数小核酸药物的技术基础，与LNP或偶联策略并非互斥关系——GalNAc-siRNA、LNP-siRNA通常同样采用2’位修饰及磷硫酰键等化学修饰手段。递送方式的演进也并非简单的代际替代，而是在用药便利性、靶向可及目标等方向上的持续拓展。除上述四种方式外，外泌体、无机纳米颗粒（金、氧化铁、硅等）等多种递送策略也处于探索之中。结语从首个反义药物问世，到GalNAc技术平台的成熟，再到抗体偶联递送向肝外组织进军，小核酸药物已完成从“概念验证”到“商业化兑现”的关键跨越。展望未来，靶点选择的精准化、递送系统的组织拓展化、化学修饰与安全性优化的持续迭代，将共同决定这一赛道的下一批赢家。对于身处其中的研发者与决策者而言，唯有建立在对全球研发数据持续追踪与深入洞察之上的判断，才能在技术迭代与研发成败交织的浪潮中把握先机。资料来源：1. title: ESMO Congress 2026 drives global dissemination of practice-changing oncology research
content:
A total of 48 studies were published simultaneously with the ESMO Congress 2026, supporting the rapid dissemination of new research findings.
The presentation of new data at the ESMO Congress 2026 was accompanied by an exceptional body of peer-reviewed scientific papers. A total of 48 studies were published concomitantly with the congress across some of the world's most influential medical journals, ensuring rapid access to findings with the potential to shape clinical practice and guiding future research.

title: 精神看病不靠只靠聊，专科大模型助力临床提质｜Nat Mach Intell探索AI辅助精神科决策新路径
content:
精神看病不靠只靠聊，专科大模型助力临床提质｜Nat Mach Intell探索AI辅助精神科决策新路径
来源：生物谷原创 2026-10-29 13:51
面向精神科开发的临床导向大语言模型，能够完成病例总结、鉴别诊断、个体化治疗规划等工作，为人工智能落地精神科临床提供可行路径。
全球近十亿人受精神障碍困扰，但稳定规范的精神科诊疗资源依旧紧缺。
和很多专科不一样，精神科缺少直观的化验或者影像指标来下定诊断。医生主要依靠倾听病史、观察行为、追踪长期症状变化综合评估病情。精神疾病的个体差异十分突出，同一种疾病，在不同患者身上的表现差别很大。再加上精神科医师缺口大，不同医生的诊疗经验参差不齐，判断结果容易出现偏差，诊疗标准化推进难度较高。
我们平时见到的心理健康AI，大多是面向普通人的情绪聊天工具。它们可以安抚情绪，却没有融入医院的诊疗流程，很难给门诊医生提供实质性的决策支持。
Nat Mach Intell发表评述文章，介绍一款专为精神科打造的大语言模型，探讨AI在诊室里辅助医生诊疗的价值。
直接使用通用大模型处理精神科临床事务，存在明显局限。通用模型的学习素材多是普通医学文献和网络内容，很难理解精神科复杂的临床细节。精神疾病之间症状常常交叉重叠，病情还会动态变化，一些容易忽视的背景信息，就会改变整体判断。多数通用模型擅长对话共情，不具备鉴别诊断、制定治疗方案需要的逻辑推导能力。而且这类模型大多只用旧病历做回顾测试，和充满不确定性的真实门诊场景存在差距。
文章重点介绍定制模型PsychFound。这款工具面向一线精神科医生，覆盖病例梳理、诊断分析、鉴别诊断、制定个体化方案和长期随访管理等全流程工作。模型整合精神专科知识与真实病历，优化诊断推理和用药推荐能力，内置治疗药物监测功能，可以结合检验结果给出用药参考，同时清晰展示每一步判断依据。不同于常见的回顾性验证，该研究开展前瞻性试验，获取真实门诊的应用数据，将通用大模型改造为适配临床流程的专科辅助工具，协助医生完善诊疗思路。

后续研究还可以纳入影像、生理信号、行为表型等多维度数据，让模型对病情的刻画更加完整。应用过程中也需要做好风险管控，坚持医师复核，严守伦理安全要求。

title: Cell：免疫治疗副作用背后的“脆弱细胞”被锁定，40%患者受影响，新靶点有望让更多人坚持抗癌治疗
content:
Cell：免疫治疗副作用背后的“脆弱细胞”被锁定，40%患者受影响，新靶点有望让更多人坚持抗癌治疗
来源：生物谷原创 2026-10-26 11:24
研究团队创建了一种免疫相关不良事件的小鼠模型。通过在免疫检查点抑制剂治疗前和治疗期间给小鼠喂食一种特殊的人类样饮食，该模型复制了人类不良事件的许多免疫和微生物组特征。
在一项新的研究中，匹兹堡大学的科学家揭示了可导致高达40%的免疫治疗患者出现严重副作用的不稳定免疫细胞，并证明饮食和微生物组组成影响副作用的严重程度。这项发表在Cell上的研究发现，在小鼠中，通过关闭“脆弱”免疫细胞中的一种蛋白质，可以逆转炎症。
“免疫相关不良事件是一个巨大的问题，可能极大影响患者的生活质量。在许多情况下，它影响患者继续接受免疫治疗或从治疗中获益的能力，”资深作者、匹兹堡大学医学院免疫学系助理教授Abigail Overacre-Delgoffe博士说。
美国食品药品管理局（FDA）尚未批准针对免疫相关不良事件的治疗方法，这是免疫检查点抑制剂（一种癌症免疫疗法）的严重副作用。
接受免疫检查点抑制剂的患者中，高达25%会出现严重不良事件，导致住院并终止治疗。其变异性使得在人类中研究它们具有挑战性，而动物模型迄今未能复制人类免疫相关炎症的复杂性。
围绕饮食构建模型
“大多数现有小鼠模型依赖于基因改造小鼠或实验条件，并未真正捕捉到我们在患者中看到的变异性，”第一作者、Overacre-Delgoffe实验室博士后助理Dipyaman Patra博士说。“这让我们思考，常见的生活方式因素，特别是饮食和肠道微生物组，是否可能在免疫治疗开始之前就影响宿主免疫系统。”
Overacre-Delgoffe领导的研究团队创建了一种免疫相关不良事件的小鼠模型。通过在免疫检查点抑制剂治疗前和治疗期间给小鼠喂食一种特殊的人类样饮食，该模型复制了人类不良事件的许多免疫和微生物组特征。
“我们能够生成首个无需完全基因敲除的不良事件临床前小鼠模型，”Overacre-Delgoffe说。“通过将这种新型临床前模型与患者数据相结合，我们能够鉴定出一种全新的不良事件机制，希望这将带来新的靶向疗法，使更多癌症患者能够继续治疗并远离医院。”
免疫检查点抑制剂的工作原理是去除称为T细胞的免疫细胞上的刹车，使它们能够更好地对抗癌症。但去除T细胞上的刹车也会影响其他组织，在某些患者中导致过度活跃的免疫细胞攻击健康组织。根据免疫检查点抑制剂的类型，20%至40%的患者会经历这些不良事件，严重程度足以中断治疗。
饮食暴露调节性T细胞的脆弱性
Overacre-Delgoffe怀疑创建动物模型的答案可能在肠道中找到。她之前的工作表明，饮食和肠道微生物组可以影响癌症患者的结局和对免疫治疗的反应。
研究人员在免疫检查点抑制剂治疗开始前两周给小鼠喂食低纤维、高脂肪和高加工碳水化合物的“西式”饮食。
这些小鼠不仅在免疫治疗期间易发生不良事件，还显示出调节性T细胞脆弱的迹象，即抑制过度免疫反应的调节性T细胞因应激而变得不稳定。研究人员随后在从免疫治疗患者收集的调节性T细胞中观察到了同样的脆弱性，这些患者患有严重的免疫相关不良事件，而没有副作用的患者则没有。
恢复细胞稳定性显著降低了免疫相关不良事件的严重程度，表明调节性T细胞脆弱性是副作用的主要潜在原因。研究团队能够通过特异性阻断调节性T细胞上的一种免疫信号蛋白，以及通过将小鼠切换到高纤维饮食或给予代谢物补充，来恢复稳定性。
微生物组转移改变炎症
喂食西式饮食的小鼠还表现出与人类免疫相关炎症相似的微生物组变化。从西式饮食喂养的小鼠到常规（高纤维）饮食小鼠的粪便微生物组转移引起了肠道炎症。从雄性小鼠（对严重不良事件较不敏感）到雌性小鼠的粪便转移降低了其炎症严重程度，表明微生物组影响免疫相关不良事件的严重程度。
此外，从食用西式饮食的患者到无菌小鼠的粪便微生物组转移导致免疫相关不良事件严重程度增加，表明饮食和肠道微生物组是这些毒性副作用的原因。
可能保留治疗的靶点
新的小鼠模型将作为研究人员的平台，以研究为什么一些患者经历严重不良事件，并帮助鉴定可能预测谁最易感的标志物。
“我们现在有一些潜在的靶点正在追求，它们似乎能限制免疫相关不良事件而不负面影响免疫治疗，这将是同类首创，非常令人兴奋，”Overacre-Delgoffe说。
未来的研究将探索潜在的组织特异性药物靶点，以限制或消除副作用而不干扰免疫治疗。代谢物补充也显示出希望，作为一种干预措施，可在不干扰微生物组的情况下降低对免疫相关不良事件的易感性。（生物谷Bioon.com）

title: ESMO and ASCO publish joint consensus statement on streamlining clinical research
content:
The joint ESMO–ASCO consensus statement reviews both societies’ initiatives and looks at how the revised Good Clinical Practice guideline can help reduce unnecessary administrative burden in clinical trials.
ESMO and the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) have published a joint consensus statement on how the revised international Good Clinical Practice guideline can help reduce unnecessary administrative burden in clinical trials . The consensus statement, published simultaneously in ESMO Open and JCO Oncology Advances, reviews both societies’ initiatives to address this issue. “The growing administrative burden of clinical research has become a major challenge for investigators and research teams, contributing to higher costs, delays and reduced research efficiency,” said Dr Teresa Amaral , ESMO co-lead of the Streamlining Clinical Research Project Group.
Good Clinical Practice (GCP) is the international standard for the design, conduct and reporting of clinical trials, developed by the International Council for Harmonisation (ICH), which brings together regulatory authorities and the pharmaceutical industry. Its latest revision, ICH E6(R3), applicable since July 2025, emphasises processes proportionate to risk, avoiding unnecessary complexity and incorporating input from investigators and patients. It also clarifies informed consent, re-consenting, source documentation and delegation practices, offering opportunities to reduce burden without compromising participant safety or data integrity.
The consensus statement was developed by the Streamlining Clinical Research Project Group of the ESMO Industry Strategic Forum (EISF), established in 2024. The Project Group brings together representatives from ESMO, ASCO and industry partners to address the increasing complexity of clinical research . “Investigators’ time should be dedicated to research and to their patients. Working with ASCO and the ESMO Industry Strategic Forum, we want to help remove procedures that add complexity without adding value,” said Dr Amaral.
“Reducing unnecessary burden in clinical research is a shared priority. By joining forces, ESMO and ASCO can help apply a more proportionate approach to clinical trials,” said Dr Julie Gralow , ASCO’s Chief Medical Officer and Executive Vice President.
The Project Group is developing practical tools . A simplified delegation log is already available, and a catalogue of data that may not need to be collected is in development. More details about the tools and the group’s objectives will be shared during a dedicated webinar on 2 November.
This collaboration reflects ESMO’s commitment to more efficient and sustainable clinical research for the benefit of patients.

title: 美国医学会发布临床AI责任框架，明确多方问责机制【AI生成】
content:
美国医学会（AMA）数字健康与人工智能中心发布了新的临床人工智能（Clinical AI）责任框架，旨在解决现有法律体系中关于AI医疗失误的责任归属模糊问题。该框架指出，当前体系可能导致医生承担无法合理预防的风险，而患者在AI造成伤害时难以寻求救济。新框架强调“共同但有区别”的责任原则：开发者需对系统设计和验证负责；医疗机构需承担部署、本地测试及结果监测的责任；医生则仅对其能实质性行使的临床判断负责，并有权拒绝使用未经验证或不符合标准的AI系统而不受惩罚。AMA主席Willie Underwood III表示，随着AI承担更多临床功能，需建立清晰的预期以保护患者、支持临床判断并确保责任由最能防止伤害的一方承担。该框架是AMA近期推出的更广泛临床AI治理框架的一部分。

银屑病患者洞察：幸福感十年提升50%，患者的“6分人生”意味着什么？
来源：生物谷 2026-10-29 11:06
每年10月29日是世界银屑病日（WPD），2026年国际银屑病协会IFPA提出全球主题"Look Beyond My Skin"，呼吁社会跳出皮肤表象，倾听银屑病患者真实的生活诉求。
每年10月29日是世界银屑病日（WPD），2026年国际银屑病协会IFPA提出全球主题"Look Beyond My Skin"，呼吁社会跳出皮肤表象，倾听银屑病患者真实的生活诉求。银屑病绝非单纯的皮肤疾患，而是关乎尊严、社交、情绪与长期生活质量的慢性系统性疾病。
值此节点，利奥制药联合京东健康、阿里健康正式发布《2026年中国银屑病患者线上购药现状与治疗满意度报告》，以横跨2017‑2021‑2026三期的追踪调研，记录中国银屑病患者近十年的生存图景，让患者真实处境被全社会看见。
本次调研依托阿里健康、京东健康双平台采样，收集到316份确诊银屑病患者的核心有效样本。受访人群以中青年为主，18‑50岁占样本总量82.6%，以轻中度皮损患者居多。
调研沿用国际通用Cantril幸福感量表（0‑10 分，0分为最差生活，10分为最好生活），同时覆盖治疗满意度、用药真实痛点、日常生活受限场景、线上购药体验、治疗经济负担等多维度问卷。这份报告不只是一份数据汇总，更是一本中国银屑病患者的 "生活状态记录簿"，聚焦院外真实世界，还原患者在日常生活里的挣扎、期盼与改变。
报告洞察：分数背后，三重现实亟待被看见
一、生活困境：皮损只是表象，心理与社会负担如影随形
报告显示，疾病带给患者的困扰早已超越皮肤本身，大量患者独自承担情绪、睡眠、社交的多重压力。
1. 超八成患者承受情绪困扰，心理支持严重缺位：86.4%受访患者存在不同程度疾病相关负面情绪，其中31.3%达到中度及以上情绪困扰，但仅有1.3%患者正在接受心理治疗或咨询，绝大多数人只能选择独自硬扛。
2. 夜间瘙痒偷走睡眠，直接拉低幸福感水平：47.2%患者会因为皮肤夜间瘙痒出现入睡困难或者痒醒。
3. 皮损轻重不等于心理负担大小，青年人遭遇 "社交隐形病"：不少青年患者皮损程度偏轻，却面临沉重社交压力。超六成患者在职场择业、婚恋亲密关系受到疾病影响；18‑29岁群体皮损大多属于轻度，但在面试、公开场合、亲密接触场景回避行为显著更高，皮肤外露带来的社交焦虑成为青年群体的核心枷锁。
二、治疗体验：疗效是底线，好用、能坚持同样重要
随着创新口服药物、生物制剂的普及，为众多中重度银屑病患者带来治疗突破，持续提升患者对治疗的期待。对于占比更高的轻中度患者，外用药仍是不可或缺的基石方案，临床应用覆盖面广，而疗效与使用体验的挑战，直接影响长期规范用药依从性。
4. 外用药应用广泛，创新升级拥有广阔空间：本次调研显示，87.0%的受访患者正在使用外用药物，是轻中度银屑病人群的首选方案。伴随各类创新治疗方案的普及，患者对于治疗效果、用药感受的期待也在不断提升，外用药仍有持续优化、提升满意度的机会。
5. 涂抹体验不佳影响治疗效果：起效慢、疗效不足、药膏黏腻沾衣、每日多次涂抹耗时费力，是外用药的高频吐槽点。数据对比显示，泡沫剂型在外用方案中满意度表现突出，满意率达到76.5%，使用者用药依从性也明显优于软膏、乳膏等传统剂型，印证剂型使用体验直接影响患者能不能长期坚持规范用药。
6. 患者的真实需求有清晰优先级：调研收集患者对新一代外用药期待，排序依次为：疗效更强＞起效更快＞不良反应更少＞日常使用便捷。疗效与安全是绝对底线，而操作简单、使用舒适，是患者进一步的核心诉求。
三、可及性变迁：线上购药释放价值，治疗可负担仍是青年痛点
7. 线上购药满意度领跑全渠道，便捷与隐私价值凸显：六大购药渠道对比中，线上电商平台满意度均分达到4.19分位居第一。87.3%线上购药患者看重省时便捷、节约往返医院时间；43.3%的患者将"保护个人隐私、规避线下购药的尴尬"列为重要选择理由。
8. 经济压力对青年群体尤为尖锐：18‑29岁青年患者群体中，20.5%将"治疗花费更可负担"列为第一位诉求，占比是年长组两倍以上。过半生物制剂使用者、近四成口服系统药物使用者表示承受较重治疗经济负担，可负担性仍是制约长期治疗的现实门槛。
十年对照：幸福指数大幅提升，但缺口依然真实
回望横跨近十年的三期追踪数据，中国银屑病患者的主观幸福感实现显著跃升：
1.从全球垫底到稳步回升，幸福感十年提升50.5%：Cantril 幸福感均分由2017年 4.28分（当年全球19国调研中位列末尾），上升2021年5.90分，2026年进一步来到6.44分，相较2017年提升50.5%。
2.幸福感分布整体上移，高分段人群明显扩容：0—4分人群占比由2021年的20.8%降至2026年的15.5%，8—10分人群占比由24.1%升至33.2%。
3.治疗信心显著上涨，但长期用药依从性仍是持久战：对治疗抱有信心患者比例，由 56.9%提升至70.3%；但依然有过半患者无法做到严格完全规律用药，坚持长期治疗依旧是现实挑战。
4.时代叙事转变：从被动"熬过去"，转向主动"活出来"。十年之间，银屑病患者的诉求发生本质变化：过去更多是忍受病痛、熬过发作期；今天，患者渴望平等求职、自在社交、拥有正常婚恋亲密关系，追求完整高质量日常生活。
面向未来：呼应全球倡议，三大方向守护患者完整人生
本次报告完整还原真实世界患者处境，呼应 IFPA 世界银屑病日"Look Beyond My Skin"核心倡议——不只看见皮损，更看见皮肤背后完整的 "人"。基于调研洞察，行业、医疗、公众需要共同奔赴三大方向：
第一，共建包容的社会环境，回应患者融入生活的诉求。破除疾病污名与偏见，传递银屑病无传染性的科学认知，守护患者在职场、社交与亲密关系中平等生活的权利。
第二，打造身心同管的诊疗路径，优化全周期治疗体验。兼顾皮损控制与身心感受，在诊疗中重视情绪、睡眠等维度；持续推动剂型创新，打磨用药体验，降低坚持规范治疗的门槛。
第三，拓宽可及的慢病支持网络，缩小治疗落地鸿沟。依托线上复诊、购药通路建设，持续提升治疗可负担性与就医便捷度，让优质的治疗方案能够真正走进患者日常。
作为医学皮肤领域全球领导者，利奥中国总经理殷晓峰先生表示，"治疗不止是提供药物，更要做患者长期同行的伙伴。未来利奥制药将持续倾听中国患者的真实声音，联合医疗平台与行业伙伴，推动诊疗从'控制皮损'走向'守护完整生活'"。
本次报告基于十年追踪调研，呈现的不只是幸福感数据，更是中国银屑病患者真实的生活状态。希望它成为一座沟通的桥梁，让更多人看见皮损之外，他们对平等社交、安心生活和从容治疗的期待——而这，正是"守护完整生活"最真实的注脚。

本期【来问讲者】邀请 夸克医药医学总监马瑞，成都纽瑞特医疗注册负责人吴文轩，中国核工业集团有限公司科技带头人、中国同辐股份有限公司首席专家李洪玉，赛赋医药副总裁、赛赋国通(无锡) 傅鹏，夸克医药市场总监、DIA中国放射性药物学术社区秘书孟祥和 ，结合各自的专业背景与实践经验，围绕放射性药物研发与临床转化中的关键问题展开分享，探讨新技术发展对临床研究的影响、创新核药研发中的监管沟通与非临床评价挑战，以及行业快速发展背景下专业交流与人才能力建设的重要性，为放射性药物创新研发与临床转化提供多元视角和实践参考。 随着AI、个体化剂量学和真实世界证据不断发展，未来放射性药物临床研究会发生哪些变化。 《2026 DIA 放射性药物进阶培训：从新型核素研发到临床转化实践》课程讲者。

总部位于马来西亚的综合生物技术平台公司 Alps Group Inc（纳斯达克代码：ALPS）于2026年10月30日召开临时股东大会（EGM），股东根据开曼群岛法律批准了所有提案。主要决议包括：(i) 将普通股和优先股按1:5比例进行股份合并；(ii) 增加公司授权股本；(iii) 采纳第二次修订和重述的组织大纲与公司章程细则。
具体变更如下：股份合并后，授权股本从5亿美元（5亿股）调整为5万美元（1亿股），每股面值由0.0001美元增至0.0005美元。随后通过股本增加，授权股本进一步从1亿股增至2.1亿股，总授权资本额从5万美元增至10.5万美元。上述“授权股本变更”将于2026年11月9日开盘时生效。生效后，Alps的流通股数量将从约1.584亿股减少至约3168万股，但股东的投票权和利益比例保持不变。合并后的股票将继续在纳斯达克全球市场以代码“ALPS”交易，新CUSIP编号为G0231P124。
